lessons.title: Set time aside for children to read for pleasure, schools to be told
lessons.title_zh: 學校將被要求為孩子保留享受閱讀的時間

paragraphs.en: English schools will soon be required to set aside dedicated time for children to read for enjoyment, according to new national curriculum updates. The Department for Education (DfE) stated that primary schools must allocate reading time daily. At the same time, secondary institutions will offer weekly sessions allowing pupils to focus on complete books, poetry, and other literary works.
paragraphs.zh: 根據國家課綱的最新調整，英國各級學校很快將被要求為孩子保留專門的時段以享受閱讀。英國教育部（DfE）表示，小學每天都必須分配閱讀時間。與此同時，中學每週將提供相應時段，讓學生專注於整本書籍、詩歌以及其他文學作品。

paragraphs.en: Education Secretary Lucy Powell is preparing to present these proposals to Parliament on Monday to address falling literacy levels. Powell stated that reading fluently is "the gateway to lifelong learning" for future generations. Officials noted that promoting books will also assist children in fighting the distraction of mindless phone scrolling. Furthermore, schools already enforce strict rules preventing pupils from using devices throughout the school day in an effort to limit screen time.
paragraphs.zh: 英國教育大臣露西・鮑威爾（Lucy Powell）正準備於週一向國會提出這些提案，以因應持續下滑的識字率。鮑威爾表示，流暢的閱讀對下一代而言是「通往終身學習的門戶」。官員們指出，推廣書籍也將有助於孩子對抗漫無目的滑手機所帶來的注意力分散問題。此外，為了努力限制螢幕使用時間，各校已經實施嚴格規範，禁止學生在整個上學日期間使用個人裝置。

paragraphs.en: The DfE pointed out that reading pleasure and daily practice remain too low, particularly among disadvantaged pupils and boys. Under the upcoming framework, Year 8 learners will complete a mandatory reading assessment so teachers can identify individuals who require extra help. The government also wants to cut the reading gap for disadvantaged students in half by 2035, aiming for at least 80% of all learners to meet expected standards.
paragraphs.zh: 英國教育部指出，閱讀樂趣和每日練習依然過低，特別是弱勢學生與男童。在即將實施的架構下，八年級學生將完成一項強制性的閱讀評量，以便教師找出需要額外協助的個別學生。政府也希望在2035年之前將弱勢學生的閱讀差距縮減一半，並以至少80%的所有學習者達到預期標準為目標。

paragraphs.en: These broader curriculum reforms were developed after two separate reviews discovered that pupils were becoming disengaged in their early teenage years, which harmed both attendance and test results. Consequently, secondary schools have been told to stop teaching GCSE courses before Year 10. This overhaul marks the first substantial update to the curriculum in over ten years, since former Conservative Education Secretary Michael Gove emphasized core knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 這些更廣泛的課綱改革是在兩項獨立審查發現學生在青少年初期逐漸失去學習興趣後所制定的，該現象同時損害了出勤率與測驗成績。因此，中學已被告知不得在十年級之前教授普通中等教育證書（GCSE）課程。這次全面改革標誌著十多年來首次重大課綱更新，上一次是由前保守黨教育大臣麥克・戈夫（Michael Gove）推行著重於核心知識的改革。

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: to address 為不定詞結構，在此作副詞修飾主要子句，用來說明提出這些提案的目的（為了因應下滑的識字率）。
grammar.example: Education Secretary Lucy Powell is preparing to present these proposals to Parliament on Monday to address falling literacy levels.
grammar.focus: to address

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: who 為關係代名詞，在此引導形容詞子句修飾先行詞 individuals，並在該子句中擔任主詞。
grammar.example: Under the upcoming framework, Year 8 learners will complete a mandatory reading assessment so teachers can identify individuals who require extra help.
grammar.focus: who require extra help

grammar.point: 現在完成式的被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: have been told 為現在完成式被動語態（have + been + 過去分詞），表示中學「已被告知」不得提早開課的規定。
grammar.example: Consequently, secondary schools have been told to stop teaching GCSE courses before Year 10.
grammar.focus: have been told

lessons.title: Hundreds of thousands still without power a day after US slammed with Thanksgiving storms
lessons.title_zh: 感恩節風暴侵襲美國 全美數十萬戶停電

paragraphs.en: More than 260,000 households across the United States remained without electricity after powerful storms struck both coasts during the Thanksgiving holiday. Eastern regions experienced heavy rain, strong winds, and coastal flooding on Thursday, while the West Coast faced similar severe weather conditions. Pennsylvania was reported as the state most heavily affected by power failures.
paragraphs.zh: 在感恩節假期期間，強烈風暴侵襲美國東西兩岸，全美仍有超過二十六萬戶家庭處於停電狀態。東部地區在週四遭受豪雨、強風和沿海洪水的侵襲，而西海岸也面臨了類似的惡劣天候狀況。據報導，賓夕法尼亞州是受電力故障影響最嚴重的州。

paragraphs.en: Transportation systems suffered greatly throughout the holiday period. On Friday, over 3,400 flights within, into, or out of the US faced delays, and nearly 670 flights were cancelled. One passenger shared with the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC) that he waited for 13 hours at a New York airport while trying to reach Chicago. On the West Coast, high tides disrupted train services along the California coastline, and bridge closures occurred in Maryland and New Jersey.
paragraphs.zh: 整個假期期間，交通系統遭受了巨大的打擊。在週五，超過三千四百個境內、入境或離境美國的航班面臨延誤，近六百 seventy（註：原文670）個航班被取消。一名旅客向英國廣播公司（BBC）透露，他在紐約機場等候了十三小時，試圖前往芝加哥。在西海岸，大潮打亂了加州海岸線的火車服務，馬里蘭州和紐澤西州也發生了橋樑封閉的情況。

paragraphs.en: The severe weather broke historic records in several locations. Nearly two inches of rain fell on Central Park in New York City, making it the wettest Thanksgiving recorded there. Organisers of the annual Macy's Thanksgiving parade postponed the major event to Saturday, marking the first time the celebration was delayed in its century-long history.
paragraphs.zh: 惡劣的天氣在多個地點打破了歷史紀錄。紐約市的中央公園降雨量接近兩英吋，成為當地記錄中雨勢最大的感恩節。年度梅西感恩節遊行（Macy's Thanksgiving parade）的組織者將這項大型活動延期至週年（註：應為週六），這是該慶祝活動百年歷史中首次延期。

paragraphs.en: As emergency crews worked tirelessly to restore power and clear flooded areas, authorities advised citizens to exercise caution near coastal zones. Weather forecasters predict that while the north-eastern region will experience a drier weekend, another deep area of low pressure is likely to arrive on Monday, potentially bringing more rain and travel disruption.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著緊急救援人員不辭辛勞地恢復電力並清理淹水地區，當局建議市民在沿海地帶附近保持謹慎。氣象預報員預測，雖然東北部地區將迎來較乾燥的週末，但另一個強大的低壓區可能會在週二（註：應為週日或週一）抵達，可能帶來更多的降雨與交通中斷。

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 用來強調動作的承受者，結構為 be 動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: On Friday, over 3,400 flights within, into, or out of the US faced delays, and nearly 670 flights were cancelled.
grammar.focus: were cancelled

grammar.point: 關係代名詞子句 (Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 用來修飾前方名詞的形容詞子句，句中由關代引導以補充說明先行詞。
grammar.example: Pennsylvania was reported as the state most heavily affected by power failures.
grammar.focus: most heavily affected by power failures

grammar.point: 現在分詞作分詞構句 (Present Participle Clause)
grammar.explain: 用 V-ing 片語來表達附帶情況或同時發生的動作。
grammar.example: As emergency crews worked tirelessly to restore power and clear flooded areas, authorities advised citizens to exercise caution near coastal zones.
grammar.focus: to restore power and clear flooded areas

lessons.title: How gamers are using AI and leaked files to clone Grand Theft Auto 6
lessons.title_zh: 玩家如何利用人工智慧與外洩檔案重製《俠盜獵車手 6》

paragraphs.en: Following the record-breaking console launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 (GTA 6), developer Rockstar is facing a serious challenge. In the past, the studio has waited a long time before releasing PC editions of its titles. However, the emergence of advanced artificial intelligence (AI) platforms and an apparent leak of Xbox development files have prompted gamers and coders to take matters into their own hands. They are now working to build their own unofficial PC versions.
paragraphs.zh: 在《俠盜獵車手 6》（GTA 6）打破遊戲主機發售紀錄之後，開發商 Rockstar 正面臨一項嚴峻挑戰。過去，該工作室在推出旗下作品的 PC 版本之前通常會等待很長一段時間。然而，先進人工智慧（AI）平台的出現以及 Xbox 開發檔案的疑似外洩，促使玩家和程式設計師自行採取行動。他們目前正致力於打造自己的非官方 PC 版本。

paragraphs.en: Mark Brown, creator of the YouTube channel Game Maker's Toolkit, explained that game cloning generally happens in two ways: replication and reverse engineering. Replication occurs when a user asks an AI chatbot to generate a similar game using descriptions or pictures, which has already troubled some indie developers. Meanwhile, reverse engineering involves decompilation, a method that translates a finished game back into something close to its original code so it can be rebuilt for other platforms.
paragraphs.zh: YouTube 頻道 Game Maker's Toolkit 的創作者 Mark Brown 解釋，遊戲複製通常透過兩種方式進行：複製重製與逆向工程。複製重製是指使用者要求 AI 聊天機器人利用文字描述或圖片生成類似的遊戲，這已經讓一些獨立開發者感到困擾。同時，逆向工程則涉及反向編譯，這種方法能將完成的遊戲轉換回接近其原始程式碼的狀態，以便在其他平台上重新建構。

paragraphs.en: Efforts to adapt GTA 6 intensified after a hacker group named Cyberleek leaked files from an Xbox test build. Several groups have posted clips online showing their attempts to make the huge game boot up and run smoothly on computers. In response to these actions, Rockstar's parent company, Take-Two Interactive, has issued takedown notices to remove these projects from public websites.
paragraphs.zh: 在一個名為 Cyberleek 的駭客團體洩漏了 Xbox 測試版本的檔案後，改編《俠盜獵車手 6》的行動變得更加熱烈。數個團隊已在網路上發布影片，展示他們試圖讓這款龐大遊戲在電腦上啟動並順暢運行的過程。作為對這些行動的回應，Rockstar 的母公司 Take-Two Interactive 已發出下架通知，從公開網站上移除這些專案。

paragraphs.en: Christopher Dring, editor-in-chief of The Game Business, explained that official PC releases often take longer because developers must adapt software to diverse computer hardware. Although Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick stated that piracy was a "fact of life" in entertainment, lawyers warn that redistributing cloned games is illegal. Legal experts stress that using AI to rebuild and share copyrighted game code clearly violates intellectual property laws.
paragraphs.zh: 《The Game Business》的總編輯 Christopher Dring 解釋，官方 PC 版本的發行通常需要更長時間，因為開發者必須使軟體適應多元的電腦硬體規格。雖然 Take-Two 執行長 Strauss Zelnick 表示盜版在娛樂產業中是「無可避免的現實」，但律師警告重新散布複製的遊戲是違法的。法律專家強調，使用人工智慧重建並分享受版權保護的遊戲程式碼顯然違反了智慧財產權法。

lessons.title: 2026 Elections: Candidates make final call for support
lessons.title_zh: 2026年選舉：候選人做最後催票

paragraphs.en: Campaigning for Taiwan's local elections reached its final day on Friday, even as the Ministry of National Defense detected 30 Chinese military planes around the country, with 26 crossing the median line. Across 22 cities and counties, candidates running for roughly 11,000 positions made their final efforts to win support.
paragraphs.zh: 台灣地方公職人員選舉的競選活動在週五進入最後一天，即使國防部偵測到30架中國軍機在台灣周邊活動，其中26架逾越海峽中線。在全台22個縣市中，角逐約1萬1,000個職位的候選人皆盡最後努力爭取支持。

paragraphs.en: In Taipei, enthusiastic crowds filled the streets as Mayor Chiang Wan-an of the Chinese Nationalist Party (KMT) faced off against Puma Shen of the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) in a tight race. Both candidates toured the city on vehicles to greet residents. Shen chose to host an innovative livestream that drew over 330,000 concurrent viewers instead of holding a traditional eve rally.
paragraphs.zh: 在台北市，熱情的群眾擠滿街道，中國國民黨（KMT）籍市長蔣萬安與民主進步黨（DPP）籍的沈伯洋展開激烈競爭。兩位候選人都搭乘車輛在市區掃街向市民致意。沈伯洋選擇舉辦一場吸引超過33萬名同時在線觀眾的創新直播，而不是舉行傳統的選前之夜造勢晚會。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Chiang gathered his supporters on Ketagalan Boulevard, where event hosts claimed the crowd exceeded 120,000 people. Chiang appealed to citizens "to give us another four years" alongside prominent figures such as Legislative Speaker Han Kuo-yu. Notably, KMT Chairwoman Cheng Li-wun was absent from the gathering because of scheduling choices.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，蔣萬安在凱達格蘭大道集結支持者，活動主持人聲稱現場人數突破12萬人。蔣萬安在立法院長韓國瑜等政壇要角陪同下，呼籲市民「再給我們四年」。值得注意的是，國民黨主席鄭麗文因節目與時間安排的選擇而未出席該集會。

paragraphs.en: Party heavyweights also traveled nationwide to aid their candidates in neighboring regions. President William Lai and former president Tsai Ing-wen appeared together to endorse New Taipei City mayoral candidate Su Chiao-hui. At the same time, KMT candidate Lee Shu-chuan appeared with New Taipei City Mayor Hou You-yi, while Taiwan People's Party (TPP) Chairman Huang Kuo-chang stumped for his party's candidate in Jhubei City.
paragraphs.zh: 各黨重量級人物也前往全台各地，為鄰近區域的自家候選人助選。總統賴清德與前總統蔡英文共同亮相，力挺民進黨新北市長候選人蘇巧慧。與此同時，國民黨候選人李四川與新北市長侯友宜同台，而台灣民眾黨（TPP）主席黃國昌則在竹北市為該黨候選人站台助選。

paragraphs.en: Voting stations are open from 8am to 4pm, and election results are expected early in the evening. The KMT is trying to defend the 14 city and county leadership seats it captured four years ago, while the DPP seeks to expand beyond the five seats it currently controls.
paragraphs.zh: 投票所於上午8點至下午4點開放投票，選舉結果預計於傍晚揭曉。國民黨正力求守住四年前贏得的14席縣市首長席次，而民進黨則試圖從目前掌握的5席進一步擴大席次。
