lessons.title: 2026 Elections: CEC reminds public no campaigning at the polls
lessons.title_zh: 2026年選舉：中央選舉委員會提醒大眾投票所不得進行競選活動

paragraphs.en: As the nation went to the polls for the nine-in-one elections, the Central Election Commission (CEC) reminded voters of important rules regarding campaign restrictions. Nearly 19.6 million eligible citizens aged 20 or older participated to choose local leaders and councilors.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著全國民眾前往投票所參加九合一選舉，中央選舉委員會（CEC）提醒選民注意有關競選限制的重要規定。將近1960萬名年滿20歲的合格公民參與投票，選出地方首長與議員。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, over 20 million people aged 18 or older were eligible to vote in a referendum concerning nuclear power policies. While public promotion for the referendum remained permitted on election day, CEC Chairman Michael You stated that using such materials to assist any candidate is strictly prohibited.
paragraphs.zh: 同時，超過2000萬名年滿18歲的民眾有資格在核能政策公投中投票。雖然公投的公開宣傳在投票日當天仍然允許，但中選會主委游盈隆表示，嚴禁利用此類宣傳品來協助任何候選人。

paragraphs.en: Regarding campaign items such as ribbons and badges, You explained that taking them into polling stations or within 30 meters of them is banned under the Civil Servants Election and Recall Act. However, simply wearing these items in public spaces does not violate the law.
paragraphs.zh: 關於緞帶與徽章等競選物品，游盈隆解釋說，根據《公職人員選舉罷免法》，將這些物品帶入投票所或其30公尺範圍內是禁止的。不過，在公共場所單純配戴這些物品並不違法。

paragraphs.en: All campaign activities officially ended at 10 pm on the previous night, and messaging apps or social media campaigning became prohibited starting at midnight. Violators face heavy fines ranging from NT$100,000 to NT$2 million.
paragraphs.zh: 所有競選活動已於前一晚十點正式結束，透過通訊軟體或社群媒體進行競選活動則自午夜起禁止。違者將面臨新台幣10萬元至200萬元不等的重罰。

paragraphs.en: In other developments, financial and trade news showed that the Financial Supervisory Commission tightened short-selling restrictions due to global market volatility. Meanwhile, the Legislative Yuan passed a bill proposing NT$20,000 for the public, and officials discussed trade policies and potential international tariffs.
paragraphs.zh: 在其他發展方面，金融與貿易新聞顯示，金融監督管理委員會因全球市場波動而收緊了放空限制。同時，立法院通過了一項向大眾發放2萬元的新法案，官員們也討論了貿易政策與潛在的國際關稅。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 用來連接子句並修飾前方名詞，在此引導形容詞子句說明公投議題。
grammar.example: Meanwhile, over 20 million people aged 18 or older were eligible to vote in a referendum concerning nuclear power policies.
grammar.focus: concerning nuclear power policies

lessons.title: DGBAS raises 2026 economic growth forecast to 13.28%
lessons.title_zh: 主計總處將2026年經濟成長預測上調至13.28%

paragraphs.en: The Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics (DGBAS) announced that Taiwan’s economy is projected to grow 13.28 percent this year. This represents the fastest pace in 48 years, mainly fueled by strong global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) products. Supported by thriving merchandise exports and rising private investment, domestic companies are increasing wages and paying bonuses. Consequently, the nation's GDP per capita is expected to reach US$46,767 this year and surpass US$50,000 next year.
paragraphs.zh: 行政院主計總處（DGBAS）宣布，台灣今年經濟預計將成長百分之十三點二八。這代表四十八年來最快的增速，主要受到全球對人工智慧（AI）產品強勁需求的推動。在繁榮的商品出口與不斷增長的民間投資支持下，國內企業正在提高工資並發放獎金。因此，台灣今年的人均國內生產毛額（GDP）預計將達到四萬六千七百六十七美元，並在明年突破五萬美元。

paragraphs.en: Despite this impressive economic momentum, potential risks remain. Tsai Yu-tai, head of the DGBAS Department of Statistics, cautioned against potential tighter regulations on AI development and further US curbs on semiconductor shipments to China, though global supply still falls short of demand. Furthermore, recent turbulence in the domestic stock market prompted the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) to ban the short-selling of stocks that dropped in the previous trading session to stabilize the market.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管有這股令人矚目的經濟動能，潛在風險依然存在。主計總處綜合統計處處長蔡鈺泰提醒，應注意針對人工智慧發展的潛在更嚴格法規，以及美國對中國半導體出口的進一步限制，儘管全球供應仍無法滿足需求。此外，近期國內股市的波動促使金融監督管理委員會（FSC）禁止放空前一交易日下跌的股票，以穩定市場。

paragraphs.en: In domestic politics, the Legislative Yuan approved a bill granting a cash payment of NT$20,000 to citizens. Proposed by the Chinese Nationalist Party (KMT) caucus, the bill was passed with a 50-46 vote. Even though all eight lawmakers from the Taiwan People’s Party (TPP) joined the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) in opposing the measure, it succeeded because thirteen DPP lawmakers were absent.
paragraphs.zh: 在國內政治方面，立法院通過了一項向民眾發放新台幣兩萬元現金的法案。該法案由中國國民黨（KMT）黨團提出，以五十票對四十六票獲得通過。儘管台灣民眾黨（TPP）的八位立法委員全數與民主進步黨（DPP）一同反對這項措施，但由於十三名民進黨立委缺席，法案依然順利通過。

paragraphs.en: On foreign and trade relations, Deputy Minister of Foreign Affairs Chen Ming-chi warned Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney that closer ties with Beijing could bring economic coercion. Meanwhile, as US President Donald Trump proposed fresh tariffs against various trading partners, a source indicated that Taiwan’s rate is expected to revert to an agreed 15 percent cap.
paragraphs.zh: 在外交與貿易關係方面，外交部政務次長陳明祺警告加拿大總理馬克．卡尼（Mark Carney），與北京深化關係可能會帶來經濟脅迫。同時，隨著美國總統唐納．川普（Donald Trump）對多個貿易夥伴提出新關稅，知情人士指出，台灣的稅率預計將恢復至已協議的百分之十五上限。

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Clause)
grammar.explain: 由過去分詞片語置於句首作副詞修飾主要子句，省略了與主詞相同且具被動語態的連接詞與主詞。
grammar.example: Supported by thriving merchandise exports and rising private investment, domestic companies are increasing wages and paying bonuses.
grammar.focus: Supported by thriving merchandise exports and rising private investment

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用 to 引導的不定詞片語置於句尾，用來說明主詞採取該項行動的具體目的。
grammar.example: Furthermore, recent turbulence in the domestic stock market prompted the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) to ban the short-selling of stocks that dropped in the previous trading session to stabilize the market.
grammar.focus: to stabilize the market

grammar.point: 讓步副詞子句 (Adverb Clause of Concession)
grammar.explain: 使用從屬連接詞 Even though 引導表示讓步的副詞子句，意為「即使、儘管」，用以修飾後面的主要子句。
grammar.example: Even though all eight lawmakers from the Taiwan People’s Party (TPP) joined the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) in opposing the measure, it succeeded because thirteen DPP lawmakers were absent.
grammar.focus: Even though all eight lawmakers from the Taiwan People’s Party (TPP) joined the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) in opposing the measure

lessons.title: School leaders vote in favour of industrial action, says union
lessons.title_zh: 教師工會表示：學校領導者投票贊成罷工行動

paragraphs.en: School leaders across Wales have decided to support industrial action regarding pay and funding issues for additional learning needs, according to the National Association of Head Teachers (NAHT).
paragraphs.zh: 根據全國校長協會（NAHT）的說法，威爾斯各地的學校領導者已決定支持關於薪資以及額外學習需求經費問題的工會行動。

paragraphs.en: The Welsh branch of the organization, known as NAHT Cymru, stated that the statutory ballot showed a clear message about increasing pressures on schools. Within a vote that had a seventy-one percent turnout, ninety-five percent of participating members supported actions short of a strike, while seventy-one percent favored actual strike action.
paragraphs.zh: 該組織的威爾斯分會稱為 NAHT Cymru，其表示法定投票結果顯示了關於學校壓力不斷增加的明確訊息。在投票率達百分之七十一的投票中，百分之九十五的參與成員支持不包含罷工的行動，而百分之七十一則贊成實際的罷工行動。

paragraphs.en: While the Welsh government offered a three and a half percent pay increase to match England, it argued that a four and a quarter percent raise was unaffordable in the current financial climate. However, the union pointed out that these figures reflect deep worries about compensation, resources, workload, and the future of school leadership.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然威爾斯政府提供百分之三點五的加薪幅度以比照英格蘭，但其主張在當前的財務環境下無法負擔百分之四點二五的調幅。然而，工會指出這些數字反映出對於薪酬、資源、工作量以及學校領導層未來的深切擔憂。

paragraphs.en: Rob Kelsall, who serves as the assistant general secretary of NAHT, described the professionals as reasonable people who do not take such steps lightly. He mentioned that the Welsh government and employers now have to decide whether to ignore warning signs or work together with the union to provide fair pay and necessary investment.
paragraphs.zh: 擔任 NAHT 助理祕書長的羅布·凱爾索（Rob Kelsall）將這些專業人士描述為不會輕易採取此類步驟的理性之人。他提到，威爾斯政府與雇主現在必須決定是選擇忽視警告訊號，還是與工會合作以提供合理的薪資和必要的投資。

paragraphs.en: The Welsh government expressed regret that the union chose to halt talks when the higher pay rise was confirmed to be impossible. Officials also noted that the organization is not currently involved in a dispute with the UK government.
paragraphs.zh: 威爾斯政府對於當確定更高的加薪幅度不可能實現時，工會選擇中斷談話表達了遺憾。官方也指出，該組織目前並未與英國政府發生爭端。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 此處用 who引導的形容詞子句來補充說明前方的特定人物身分。
grammar.example: Rob Kelsall, who serves as the assistant general secretary of NAHT, described the professionals as reasonable people who do not take such steps lightly.
grammar.focus: who serves as the assistant general secretary of NAHT

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 此處使用「be動詞 + 過去分詞」來表達受詞承受動作的狀態。
grammar.example: The Welsh government expressed regret that the union chose to halt talks when the higher pay rise was confirmed to be impossible.
grammar.focus: was confirmed

grammar.point: 副詞子句表條件 (Adverbial Clause of Condition)
grammar.explain: 此處使用連接詞 while 引導讓步或對比的副詞子句，連接兩個相關的句子。
grammar.example: While the Welsh government offered a three and a half percent pay increase to match England, it argued that a four and a quarter percent raise was unaffordable in the current financial climate.
grammar.focus: While the Welsh government offered a three and a half percent pay increase to match England

lessons.title: Capsized tanker carrying 7,000 tonnes of diesel to be towed away from Ibiza
lessons.title_zh: 載有七千噸柴油的翻覆油輪將從伊薩比亞拖離

paragraphs.en: A cargo ship transporting diesel capsized near the popular vacation island of Ibiza in Spain. All seventeen crew members of the Malta-registered vessel were safely rescued from the water, although the chief engineer tragically passed away later at a hospital. Additionally, six individuals received medical treatment for minor physical injuries after the accident.
paragraphs.zh: 一艘載運柴油的貨船在西班牙熱門度假島嶼伊薩比亞（Ibiza）附近翻覆。這艘懸掛馬爾他註冊旗幟的船隻上，所有十七名船員都從水中獲救，不過總工程師後來不幸在醫院過世。此外，有六個人在事故後接受了輕微身體傷害的醫療治療。

paragraphs.en: Initial fears of an ecological crisis in the western Mediterranean Sea decreased after safety checks revealed the fuel storage compartments remained undamaged. The vessel was originally heading from Algeciras toward Barcelona when the emergency occurred. Spanish transportation officials stated that the ship will be towed to the port of Cartagena because it possesses the necessary technical facilities for cargo removal and repair tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在安全檢查顯示燃料儲存隔間保持完好之後，西地中海發生生態危機的最初擔憂減輕了。當緊急情況發生時，該船原本正從阿爾赫西拉斯（Algeciras）駛向巴塞隆納。西班牙交通官員表示，該船將被拖往卡塔赫納（Cartagena）港口，因為該港具備進行貨物移除和修理工作的必要技術設施。

paragraphs.en: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez mentioned that the situation is stabilised and expressed hope that the vessel could reach port very soon. He noted that the information suggests this leak is not happening. Meanwhile, regional emergency director Pablo Gárriz clarified that the ship has not completely sunk into the sea as previously claimed, but remains partially submerged instead.
paragraphs.zh: 首相佩德羅·桑切斯（Pedro Sánchez）提到情況已經穩定，並表達希望該船能夠在極快時間內抵達港口。他指出，相關資訊顯示這種洩漏並沒有發生。同時，區域緊急事務主任帕布羅·加里茲（Pablo Gárriz）澄清說，該船並未如先前聲稱的那樣完全沉入海中，而是部分沒入水中。

paragraphs.en: The maritime accident took place twenty-five nautical miles away from the coastline of Ibiza and fifty-seven nautical miles away from Valencia. Local authorities received a distress call late on Wednesday. Minutes later, the crew reported a severe leak and a ninety-degree tilting angle before the ship capsized early Thursday morning. Investigations regarding the exact cause of the incident are currently under way.
paragraphs.zh: 這起海難發生在距離伊薩比亞海岸線二十五海里以及距離瓦倫西亞五十七海里的地方。當地當局在週三深夜接獲求救電話。幾分鐘後，船員回報了嚴重的洩漏以及九十度的傾斜角度，隨後該船在週四清晨翻覆。目前正在進行關於該事件確切原因的調查。

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 本句使用被動語態「be + 過去分詞」來表達十七名船員被安全救起的事實。
grammar.example: All seventeen crew members of the Malta-registered vessel were safely rescued from the water, although the chief engineer tragically passed away later at a hospital.
grammar.focus: were safely rescued

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participial Clause)
grammar.explain: 本句使用逗號隔開的 V-ing 分詞構句來補充說明首相桑切斯表達希望時的動作。
grammar.example: Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez mentioned that the situation is stabilised and expressed hope that the vessel could reach port very soon.
grammar.focus: expressed hope

grammar.point: 過去分詞作形容詞 (Past Participle as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 本句使用過去分詞「submerged」作為形容詞，用來補充描述船隻部分沒入水中的狀態。
grammar.example: Local authorities received a distress call late on Wednesday. Minutes later, the crew reported a severe leak and a ninety-degree tilting angle before the ship capsized early Thursday morning.
grammar.focus: capsized

lessons.title: Astronomers ‘disheartened’ by decision allowing SpaceX to deploy satellites for space datacenters
lessons.title_zh: 監管機構批准 SpaceX 部署太空資料中心衛星，天文學家深感「沮喪」

paragraphs.en: US federal regulators have recently approved an ambitious project from Elon Musk's company, SpaceX. The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) granted a license allowing SpaceX to launch up to one million satellites into low Earth orbit. Known as the Starmind program, this plan seeks to move artificial intelligence data centers into space. Brendan Carr, the FCC chair, praised the decision, stating, "America is leading the world into the era of super intelligence."
paragraphs.zh: 美國聯邦監管機構最近批准了伊隆·馬斯克（Elon Musk）旗下的 SpaceX 公司一項雄心勃勃的計畫。美國聯邦傳播委員會（FCC）發放了一張許可證，允許 SpaceX 發射多達一百萬顆衛星進入近地軌道。這項名為 Starmind 的計畫旨在將人工智慧資料中心轉移到太空。FCC 主席布倫丹·卡爾（Brendan Carr）讚揚了這項決定，表示：「美國正引領世界進入超級智能時代。」

paragraphs.en: Supporters argue that orbital facilities can directly capture continuous solar energy, which significantly reduces the huge electricity and water demands of terrestrial computer centers. However, the American Astronomical Society expressed that it was deeply disheartened by the ruling. The organization warned that bright satellites will produce light pollution and harmful radio interference, which could damage decades of scientific investments and disturb researchers studying the night sky.
paragraphs.zh: 支持者主張，軌道設施可以直接獲取源源不絕的太陽能，這將大幅降低地面電腦中心對電力和水資源的龐大需求。然而，美國天文學會表示對此裁定深感沮喪。該組織警告，明亮的衛星將產生光害和有害的無線電干擾，這可能會損害數十年的科學投資，並干擾研究夜空的研究人員。

paragraphs.en: Other organizations have also voiced severe technical and environmental warnings. A report by the Government Accountability Office (GAO) pointed out that space does not cool computer equipment efficiently, which poses a serious engineering challenge. In addition, crowded orbits dramatically increase collision risks. Under the approved license, SpaceX must begin deployment by November 2033, launch 100,000 satellites by November 2035, and deploy half of the total by November 2038.
paragraphs.zh: 其他機構也提出了嚴重的技術和環境警告。美國政府問責署（GAO）的一份報告指出，太空無法有效冷卻電腦設備，這構成了嚴重的工程挑戰。此外，擁擠的軌道大幅增加了碰撞風險。根據核准的許可證，SpaceX 必須在 2033 年 11 月前開始部署，在 2035 年 11 月前發射 10 萬顆衛星，並在 2038 年 11 月前部署總數的一半。

paragraphs.en: Competitors like Amazon's satellite unit, Leo, expressed doubt that SpaceX could actually deploy so many satellites. Meanwhile, a study from Columbia University emphasized that placing even one-tenth of expected AI computing centers into orbit would require about two rocket launches per day indefinitely. Experts worry that such frequent rocket activity could cause atmospheric pollution, damage the ozone layer, and leave dangerous orbital debris before global regulations are ready.
paragraphs.zh: 亞馬遜旗下的衛星部門 Leo 等競爭對手對 SpaceX 是否真的能部署這麼多衛星表示懷疑。與此同時，哥倫比亞大學的一項研究強調，即使只將預期 AI 運算中心的十分之一送入軌道，也將需要每天進行大約兩次火箭發射，並且永久持續。專家擔心，在做出充分的全球規範之前，如此頻繁的火箭活動可能會造成大氣污染、破壞臭氧層，並留下危險的軌道碎片。

grammar.point: 現在分詞片語作後位修飾 (Present Participle Phrase as Postmodifier)
grammar.explain: 現在分詞片語「allowing...」放在名詞 a license 後方，修飾該名詞並表達主動功能。
grammar.example: The Federal Communications Commission (FCC) granted a license allowing SpaceX to launch up to one million satellites into low Earth orbit.
grammar.focus: allowing SpaceX to launch

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 由逗號加「which」引導的非限定關係代名詞子句，補充說明先行詞「continuous solar energy」帶來的影響。
grammar.example: Supporters argue that orbital facilities can directly capture continuous solar energy, which significantly reduces the huge electricity and water demands of terrestrial computer centers.
grammar.focus: , which significantly reduces

grammar.point: 動名詞當主詞 (Gerund as Subject)
grammar.explain: 動名詞片語「placing...」在 that 子句中擔任主詞，動詞使用單數形式 would require。
grammar.example: Meanwhile, a study from Columbia University emphasized that placing even one-tenth of expected AI computing centers into orbit would require about two rocket launches per day indefinitely.
grammar.focus: placing even one-tenth of expected AI computing centers into orbit

lessons.title: Labour row over Rosebank deepens as dozens of MPs warn PM not to block oilfield
lessons.title_zh: 隨著數十名議員警告首相切勿阻擋油田，工黨內部對羅斯班克的爭執加劇

paragraphs.en: A serious disagreement has broken out within the UK Labour Party regarding the Rosebank oilfield in the North Sea. Prime Minister Andy Burnham must choose between two opposing sides within his own party. Nearly one hundred lawmakers have urged him to stop the project because of its impact on the climate. They argue that Rosebank will produce an estimated 254 million tonnes of carbon dioxide over its lifetime, which they believe is not worth the extra 500 jobs and 500 million pounds in tax receipts.
paragraphs.zh: 英國工黨內部針對北海的羅斯班克油田爆發了嚴重的分歧。首相安迪‧伯納姆必須在自己政黨內的兩個對立派系之間做出選擇。將近一百名議員敦促他停止該計畫，理由是對氣候的衝擊。他們主張，羅斯班克在整個運作期間估計將產生2.54億噸的二氧化碳，他們認為這並不值得換取額外的500個工作機會與5億英鎊的稅收。

paragraphs.en: On the other hand, up to 80 pro-drilling politicians want the project to continue. Scottish Labour leader Michael Marra also backs the plan, stating that the decline of the North Sea basin threatens working-class people in vocational jobs. Supporters argue that rejecting Rosebank would damage Labour's image among workers and industry. In fact, one politician cautioned that rejecting the oilfield could spell "lights out for Labour in Scotland."
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，多達80名支持鑽探的政界人士則希望該計畫繼續進行。蘇格蘭工黨黨魁麥可‧馬拉也支持這項計畫，並指出北海盆地的衰退正威脅著從事職業技術工作的勞工階層。支持者主張，拒絕羅斯班克將損害工黨在勞工與產業界眼中的形象。事實上，一名政界人士警告，否決該油田可能意味著「工黨在蘇格蘭的熄燈」。

paragraphs.en: In Scotland, public opinion seems to lean toward approval. A survey conducted by Survation found that 64 percent of people in Scotland believe the UK government should approve Rosebank, compared to only 16 percent who oppose it. Analysts point out that Burnham's hopes of winning a stable majority rely heavily on winning Scottish seats, making the voter reaction extremely important for his political future.
paragraphs.zh: 在蘇格蘭，大眾民意似乎傾向於同意批准。由Survation進行的一項調查發現，64%的蘇格蘭人認為英國政府應批准羅斯班克，而反對者僅佔16%。分析師指出，伯納姆贏得穩定多數席次的希望高度依賴蘇格蘭的席次，這使得選民的反應對他的政治前途格外重要。

paragraphs.en: Officially, Energy Secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh must decide whether to grant environmental approval. Reports suggest she leans against approving the plan because of environmental harm, but most lawmakers believe she will support Burnham's final stance. Although Burnham wants to take a practical approach, he faces a delicate balance, as some ministerial aides have already indicated they might resign if he pushes for approval.
paragraphs.zh: 在官方程序上，能源大臣米雅塔‧范布勒必須決定是否給予環境許可。報導指出，由於環境損害，她傾向不批准該計畫，但多數議員認為她將支持伯納姆的最終立場。儘管伯納姆希望能採取務實的做法，但他面臨著微妙的平衡，因為一些內閣幕僚已經表示，若他推動批准，他們可能會辭職。

grammar.point: 現在完成式 (Present Perfect Tense)
grammar.explain: 句中以「has + 過去分詞」表示過去已經發生、且其影響延續至現在的動作。
grammar.example: A serious disagreement has broken out within the UK Labour Party regarding the Rosebank oilfield in the North Sea.
grammar.focus: has broken out

grammar.point: 關係代名詞引導的形容詞子句 (Relative Clause with Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 由關係代名詞 who 引導形容詞子句，修飾先行詞 16 percent（的人）。
grammar.example: A survey conducted by Survation found that 64 percent of people in Scotland believe the UK government should approve Rosebank, compared to only 16 percent who oppose it.
grammar.focus: who oppose it

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 逗號後使用現在分詞 making 引導分詞片語，用來補充說明主句所帶來的結果或伴隨狀態。
grammar.example: Analysts point out that Burnham's hopes of winning a stable majority rely heavily on winning Scottish seats, making the voter reaction extremely important for his political future.
grammar.focus: making the voter reaction extremely important for his political future

lessons.title: Google told to halt Belgium datacentre construction over lack of planning permit
lessons.title_zh: 因缺乏規劃許可證 Google被要求停建比利時資料中心

paragraphs.en: Belgian authorities have ordered Google to stop building a massive datacentre in the south of the country. The American tech company had asked to change its original planning permission, but those changes did not receive final approval. Despite this lack of permission, officials discovered that the construction work was still going on.
paragraphs.zh: 比利時當局已下令 Google 停止在該國南部建造一座大型資料中心。這家美國科技公司曾要求修改其原本的規劃許可，但這些變更並未獲得最終批准。儘管缺乏這項許可，官員們仍發現施工仍在進行。

paragraphs.en: Inspectors visited the site at Aiseau-Presles, which is located about 15 kilometres west of Charleroi. They found that the three-hectare building was nearly finished and its basic structure was already complete. Wallonia regional official Raphaël Stokis stated that about 300 workers received verbal orders to stop, which were later confirmed in writing to the company. In response, Google said it was "committed to maintaining an open and collaborative dialogue" with regional authorities.
paragraphs.zh: 督察員造訪了位於沙勒羅瓦（Charleroi）以西約十五公里的艾索-普雷勒（Aiseau-Presles）工地。他們發現這座佔地三公頃的建築幾乎已經完工，且基本結構也已完成。瓦隆尼亞（Wallonia）地區官員拉斐爾．斯托基斯（Raphaël Stokis）表示，大約三百名工人接到了口頭停工命令，隨後並以書面形式向該公司確認。對此，Google 表示該公司「致力於與地區當局保持公開且協作的對話」。

paragraphs.en: The dispute began after Google attempted to modify its 2024 plan. At first, the company wanted to build three smaller facilities using air cooling. However, in 2025, it asked to combine two buildings into one giant centre. This new design would use liquid cooling, drawing 600 cubic metres of water per hour from the nearby Sambre River. Although regional officials initially approved the change in April, the infrastructure minister revoked the permit in August because of drought concerns.
paragraphs.zh: 這場紛爭始於 Google 企圖修改其 2024 年的計畫。起初，該公司想要建造三座採用氣冷散熱的較小型設施。然而，在 2025 年，該公司要求將其中兩棟建築合併為一座超大中心。這項新設計將採用液冷散熱，每小時從附近的桑布爾河（Sambre River）抽取六百立方公尺的水。雖然地區官員最初在四月批准了該變更，但基礎建設部長因擔憂乾旱而在八月撤銷了該許可證。

paragraphs.en: Recently, the environmental organisation Greenpeace published drone footage proving that work was still continuing. Nicolas Yernaux, a regional government spokesperson, said officials are submitting a report about this illegal construction to public prosecutors. Meanwhile, Google has appealed the government's decision to Belgium's Council of State, and a ruling is expected on January 7.
paragraphs.zh: 最近，環保組織綠色和平（Greenpeace）公佈了無人機空拍影片，證明工程仍在持續。地區政府發言人尼可拉斯．耶爾諾（Nicolas Yernaux）表示，官員正在向檢察官提交一份關於這項非法施工的報告。在此同時，Google 已就政府的決定向比利時國務院提出申訴，預計將於 1 月 7 日做出裁決。

paragraphs.en: This legal battle is not the only challenge Google faces in Europe. Big tech firms are rushing to build datacentres to support the boom in artificial intelligence (AI). In October, Finland also launched a criminal investigation into possible environmental law violations at another planned Google datacentre, where construction remains halted until environmental impact assessments are finished.
paragraphs.zh: 這場法律戰並非 Google 在歐洲面臨的唯一挑戰。大型科技公司正爭相興建資料中心，以支持人工智慧（AI）的蓬勃發展。十月，芬蘭也針對另一處規劃中的 Google 資料中心可能違反環境法規展開刑事調查，該處施工將持續暫停，直到環境影響評估完成為止。

grammar.point: 非限定關係子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 逗號後使用關係代名詞 which 引導非限定關係子句，用來補充說明先行詞 Aiseau-Presles 的地理位置。
grammar.example: Inspectors visited the site at Aiseau-Presles, which is located about 15 kilometres west of Charleroi.
grammar.focus: , which is located about 15 kilometres west of Charleroi

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 以逗號連接現在分詞 drawing 引導分詞片語，省略連接詞與主詞，用以補充說明該液冷設計伴隨的抽水狀況。
grammar.example: This new design would use liquid cooling, drawing 600 cubic metres of water per hour from the nearby Sambre River.
grammar.focus: , drawing 600 cubic metres of water per hour from the nearby Sambre River

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 不定詞片語 to support 作為副詞修飾動詞，用來說明各大科技公司急於興建資料中心的目的。
grammar.example: Big tech firms are rushing to build datacentres to support the boom in artificial intelligence (AI).
grammar.focus: to support the boom in artificial intelligence (AI)

lessons.title: British Gas owner seeks urgent government talks over future of storage facility
lessons.title_zh: 英國天然氣公司老闆尋求政府緊急會談以商討儲存設施的未來

paragraphs.en: The chief executive of Centrica, the company that owns British Gas, recently sent an internal memo to hundreds of workers at the Rough gas storage facility. Located off the east coast of Yorkshire, this underground gas plant supports about four hundred jobs, including direct employees and outside contractors.
paragraphs.zh: 英國瓦斯公司（British Gas）母公司森特理卡（Centrica）的執行長最近向羅夫（Rough）天然氣儲存設施的數百名員工發送了一份內部備忘錄。這座地下天然氣廠位於約克郡東海岸外海，支持了大約四百個工作機會，包含直接雇員與外包承攬商。

paragraphs.en: According to the memo, the top boss is seeking urgent talks with government officials, trade unions, and the prime minister because the facility is scheduled to close at the end of March. The company stated that it would do everything possible to save jobs for the staff members at the site.
paragraphs.zh: 根據該備忘錄，由於該設施預定在三月底關閉，這位高階主管正在尋求與政府官員、工會及首相進行緊急會談。該公司表示，將盡一切可能為該場地的員工保住工作。

paragraphs.en: The planned closure happens because running the ageing site has become uneconomic. Normally, companies store gas in the summer when market prices are lower and sell it in winter when prices increase due to heavy demand. However, recent energy crises have changed this pattern, making it very difficult to earn enough money for necessary facility upgrades.
paragraphs.zh: 計劃中的關閉是因為營運這個老舊場地已變得不符合經濟效益。通常情況下，公司會在市場價格較低的夏天儲存天然氣，並在需求大增導致價格上漲的冬天出售。然而，近期的能源危機改變了這種模式，使得賺取足夠資金來進行必要的設施升級變得非常困難。

paragraphs.en: Before this announcement, the government already turned down a request for short-term financial help to keep the store operating through the coming winter. Furthermore, officials delayed answering a consultation regarding long-term support for these underground gas stores, which caused great disappointment within the utility firm.
paragraphs.zh: 在此公告之前，政府已經拒絕了一項短期財務援助的請求，以維持該儲存槽度過即將到來的冬天。此外，官員們延遲回覆關於長期支持這些地下天然氣儲存槽的諮詢，這在該公用事業公司內部引起了極大的失望。

paragraphs.en: This warning follows a similar announcement by another energy company named SSE, which stated it would shut down its own gas storage site next summer without government backing. Meanwhile, the National Energy System Operator recently warned that the United Kingdom is facing a serious risk of a gas supply crisis as domestic production decreases.
paragraphs.zh: 此項警告發生在另一家名為SSE的能源公司發出類似公告之後不久，該公司表示若無政府支持，將於明年夏天關閉其自身的天然氣儲存場地。同時，國家能源系統運營商（National Energy System Operator, Neso）最近警告說，隨著國內產量減少，英國正面臨天然氣供應危機的嚴重風險。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞子句 (Relative clause)
grammar.explain: 使用關代子句補充說明前面的名詞 company。
grammar.example: The chief executive of Centrica, the company that owns British Gas, recently sent an internal memo to hundreds of workers at the Rough gas storage facility.
grammar.focus: that owns British Gas

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive voice)
grammar.explain: 表達設施被預定在三月底關閉，使用「be + V-pp」的被動結構。
grammar.example: According to the memo, the top boss is seeking urgent talks with government officials, trade unions, and the prime minister because the facility is scheduled to close at the end of March.
grammar.focus: is scheduled to close

grammar.point: 目的副詞片語 (Adverbial clause of purpose)
grammar.explain: 用來表達為了在冬天價格上漲時出售天然氣的目的。
grammar.example: Normally, companies store gas in the summer when market prices are lower and sell it in winter when prices increase due to heavy demand.
grammar.focus: when prices increase due to heavy demand

lessons.title: Federal regulators shut $6 billion Indiana lender in biggest bank failure in over two years
lessons.title_zh: 聯邦監管機構關閉印第安納州資產達六十億美元的借貸機構，創下兩年多來最大銀行倒閉案

paragraphs.en: Federal regulators closed down United Fidelity, a bank based in Indiana, marking the largest banking failure in the United States since April 2024. The Federal Deposit Insurance Corp. (FDIC) announced that another lender, First Citizens, agreed to take over all deposits and assets of the troubled bank. This closure is the second-largest collapse since the regional banking crisis in 2023, when institutions like Silicon Valley Bank collapsed.
paragraphs.zh: 聯邦監管機構關閉了總部位於印第安納州的聯合富達銀行（United Fidelity），這標誌著自2024年4月以來美國最大的銀行倒閉事件。美國聯邦存款保險公司（FDIC）宣布，另一家借貸機構第一公民銀行（First Citizens）已同意接管這家陷入困境之銀行的所有存款與資產。這次倒閉是自2023年區域銀行危機以來的第二大崩潰，當時包括矽谷銀行（Silicon Valley Bank）等機構相繼倒閉。

paragraphs.en: Officials from the FDIC assured customers that they will retain their money and deposit insurance coverage under First Citizens. Over the weekend, depositors could continue accessing their funds through automated teller machines (ATMs), debit cards, and checks. Furthermore, all twenty-two branches of United Fidelity located across Indiana, Illinois, Florida, Colorado, and the US Virgin Islands were scheduled to reopen as First Citizens branches on Saturday.
paragraphs.zh: FDIC的官員向客戶保證，他們轉為第一公民銀行的客戶後將保留所有資金與存款保險保障。在週末期間，存款人可以繼續透過自動櫃員機（ATM）、簽帳金融卡以及開立支票來動用其資金。此外，聯合富達銀行分佈於印第安納州、伊利諾州、佛羅里達州、科羅拉多州和美屬維京群島的所有二十二家分行，預計於週六以第一公民銀行分行的形式重新營業。

paragraphs.en: The collapse caused severe financial damage, revealing how troubled the lender was when authorities intervened. The FDIC estimated that the failure will wipe out $1.83 billion from the industry deposit insurance fund, which equaled an unusually high thirty-one percent loss on United Fidelity’s $5.9 billion in assets. In addition, First Citizens agreed to take on $3.1 billion of loans only after receiving a steep discount of $2.6 billion, suggesting serious concern that those loans were troubled.
paragraphs.zh: 這場倒閉造成了嚴重的財務損失，揭示出該借貸機構在主管機關介入時陷入了多麼嚴重的困境。FDIC估計，這起倒閉事件將耗損該產業存款保險基金中的18.3億美元，這相當於聯合富達銀行截至9月底59億美元資產中高達百分之三十一的異常龐大損失。此外，第一公民銀行是在獲得26億美元巨額折價後，才同意承接31億美元的貸款，這表明其嚴重擔憂這些貸款存在問題。

paragraphs.en: Although United Fidelity held $5.4 billion in deposits at the end of September, First Citizens agreed to assume only $4.5 billion, excluding certain brokered deposits. The FDIC did not explain how many accounts were excluded or why. Still, First Citizens chief executive officer Frank Holding Jr. welcomed the deal, stating, "We believe this transaction is both financially and strategically compelling." He also stated that his company looks forward to earning the trust of its new customers.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管聯合富達銀行截至9月底持有54億美元的存款，但第一公民銀行僅同意承接45億美元，排除掉了特定的仲介存款。FDIC並未解釋有多少帳戶被排除在外或其原因。儘管如此，第一公民銀行執行長法蘭克．霍爾丁二世（Frank Holding Jr.）仍對這項交易表示歡迎，並表示：「我們相信這筆交易在財務與策略上都極具吸引力。」他也表示，其公司期待贏得新客戶的信任。

grammar.point: 分詞片語作結果說明 (Participle Phrase of Result)
grammar.explain: marking 引導現在分詞片語，置於逗號之後，用來修飾前面整件事所產生的結果。
grammar.example: Federal regulators closed down United Fidelity, a bank based in Indiana, marking the largest banking failure in the United States since April 2024.
grammar.focus: marking the largest banking failure in the United States since April 2024

grammar.point: 名詞子句作受詞 (Noun Clause as an Object)
grammar.explain: that 引導的名詞子句放在動詞 assured 與受詞 customers 之後，作為主要動詞的直接受詞，說明保證的具體內容。
grammar.example: Officials from the FDIC assured customers that they will retain their money and deposit insurance coverage under First Citizens.
grammar.focus: that they will retain their money and deposit insurance coverage under First Citizens

grammar.point: 讓步副詞子句 (Adverb Clause of Concession)
grammar.explain: 從屬連接詞 although 引導副詞子句表示「雖然……」，用來對比主要子句中的情況。
grammar.example: Although United Fidelity held $5.4 billion in deposits at the end of September, First Citizens agreed to assume only $4.5 billion, excluding certain brokered deposits.
grammar.focus: Although United Fidelity held $5.4 billion in deposits at the end of September

lessons.title: OpenAI countersues Apple in ongoing trade secrets fight
lessons.title_zh: OpenAI 在持續的商業機密爭端中對蘋果提出反訴

paragraphs.en: The legal battle between OpenAI and Apple has escalated. On Friday, OpenAI filed a countersuit against the iPhone maker in a Northern California federal court, accusing Apple of unfair business practices. This conflict is the latest development in an ongoing fight over trade secrets, as both technology giants compete to build the next generation of personal devices powered by artificial intelligence (AI).
paragraphs.zh: OpenAI 與蘋果公司（Apple）之間的法律戰已經升級。週五，OpenAI 在北加州聯邦法院對這家 iPhone 製造商提起反訴，指控蘋果進行不公平的商業行為。這場衝突是商業機密爭奪戰的最新進展，兩大科技巨頭正競相打造由人工智慧（AI）驅動的下一代個人裝置。

paragraphs.en: The dispute dates back to July, when Apple sued OpenAI and two former employees, claiming they stole confidential information to develop an AI gadget. In response, OpenAI denied the accusations and later argued that another worker had taken trade secrets to Apple. In its new countersuit, OpenAI claims Apple intentionally encourages workers to store business files on their personal accounts. When employees resign to join a rival, Apple reportedly dismisses them immediately on the same day, giving them no time to separate private data from company records. OpenAI argues this policy creates an unfair trap to accuse former staff of theft.
paragraphs.zh: 這場紛爭可追溯至七月，當時蘋果起訴了 OpenAI 及兩名前員工，指控他們竊取機密資訊以開發 AI 裝置。對此，OpenAI 否認了這些指控，並在數月後主張另一名員工將商業機密帶到了蘋果。在新的反訴中，OpenAI 聲稱蘋果故意鼓勵員工將工作檔案存放在個人帳號中。據報導，當員工辭職加入競爭對手時，蘋果會在同一天立即將他們解僱，讓他們沒有時間將私人資料與公司紀錄分開。OpenAI 認為這項政策製造了一個不公平的陷阱，讓蘋果得以指控前員工竊取機密。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, OpenAI stated that Apple decided to take legal action because it has struggled to add innovative AI features to its products. According to OpenAI, Apple also pressured suppliers not to collaborate with the AI firm. However, an Apple spokesperson pushed back against these claims, describing OpenAI's arguments as "a transparent attempt to distract" from the real issue. Apple explained that its original lawsuit involves deliberate theft of unreleased technology, rather than the accidental retention of data.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，OpenAI 表示蘋果決定採取法律行動，是因為該公司難以將創新的 AI 功能整合進其產品中。根據 OpenAI 的說法，蘋果還向供應商施壓，要求他們不要與這家 AI 公司合作。然而，蘋果發言人反駁了這些說法，將 OpenAI 的論點形容為「轉移焦點的明顯企圖」，企圖偏離真正的問題。蘋果解釋，其最初的訴訟涉及故意竊取未公開技術，而非意外保留資料。

paragraphs.en: Apple also maintained that it trains employees to keep work separate from personal files and does not punish workers for honest mistakes. In addition, Apple said it found no evidence of wrongdoing by its new staff members and promised to remove any OpenAI files if they are discovered on its systems. Meanwhile, other tech companies like Amazon, Google, and Meta are also racing to create AI hardware. Both Apple and OpenAI have now requested a jury trial to resolve the fight.
paragraphs.zh: 蘋果亦堅稱有培訓員工將工作檔案與個人檔案分開，並且不會懲罰犯下無心之過的員工。此外，蘋果表示並未發現其新進員工有任何不法行為的證據，並承諾如果在其系統中發現任何 OpenAI 的檔案，將會進行清除。與此同時，亞馬遜（Amazon）、Google 與 Meta 等其他科技公司也正競相開發 AI 硬體。蘋果與 OpenAI 目前都已要求由陪審團審判來解決這場爭端。

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Construction)
grammar.explain: 由現在分詞 accusing 引導分詞構句，修飾主要子句，補充說明主要動作發生時伴隨的情況。
grammar.example: On Friday, OpenAI filed a countersuit against the iPhone maker in a Northern California federal court, accusing Apple of unfair business practices.
grammar.focus: accusing Apple of unfair business practices

grammar.point: 關係副詞引導非限定子句 (Non-defining Relative Clause with Relative Adverb)
grammar.explain: when 為關係副詞，引導逗號後的非限定關係子句，補充說明前方表示時間的名詞 July。
grammar.example: The dispute dates back to July, when Apple sued OpenAI and two former employees, claiming they stole confidential information to develop an AI gadget.
grammar.focus: when Apple sued OpenAI and two former employees

grammar.point: 名詞子句作動詞受詞 (Noun Clause as Object)
grammar.explain: that 為連接詞，引導完整的名詞子句作為主要動詞 maintained 的受詞。
grammar.example: Apple also maintained that it trains employees to keep work separate from personal files and does not punish workers for honest mistakes.
grammar.focus: that it trains employees to keep work separate from personal files and does not punish workers for honest mistakes

lessons.title: For Nike, a comeback is a marathon and not a sprint
lessons.title_zh: 對Nike而言，東山再起是一場馬拉松而非短跑

paragraphs.en: Nike is currently working on a turnaround plan after facing several years of flat or declining sales and a drop in stock price. Chief Executive Officer Elliott Hill admitted that the athletic footwear and apparel company is not where it wants to be. Employees are also preparing for another potential round of layoffs next year under his leadership.
paragraphs.zh: 在面臨連續幾年銷售持平或下滑以及股價下跌後，Nike目前正在擬定振興計畫。執行長艾略特・希爾坦承，這家運動鞋服公司並未達到理想的狀態。在他的領導下，員工們也正為明年可能到來的另一波裁員作好準備。

paragraphs.en: According to research analyst Joseph Civello, the company's troubles are largely self-induced because of a previous strategy shift. The brand previously decided to sell products mainly through its own websites and stores instead of traditional retailers. This approach made the company complacent, leading to repeated product designs without true innovation while smaller competitors gained market share.
paragraphs.zh: 根據研究分析師約瑟夫・西韋洛的說法，該公司的困境在很大程度上是由於先前的策略轉變所造成的自作自受。該品牌先前決定主要透過自身的網站和商店販賣產品，而不是依賴傳統零售商。這種做法使該公司變得自滿，導致產品設計重複卻缺乏真正的創新，同時較小的競爭對手則贏得了市佔率。

paragraphs.en: To rebuild the business, Hill plans to improve product innovation and restore partnerships with independent stores. The brand will focus heavily on performance sports like running and basketball while also updating its supply chain to respond faster to trends. However, executives warned that the financial benefits of these changes will take years to appear, and revenue could remain flat or drop for another two years.
paragraphs.zh: 為了重建業務，希爾計畫提升產品創新並恢復與獨立商店的合作關係。該品牌將重心大幅放在跑步和籃球等競技運動上，同時更新供應鏈以更快回應潮流。然而，高層警告這些改變帶來的財務效益需要數年時間才會顯現，且營收可能會再持平或下滑兩年。

paragraphs.en: The company also faces challenges overseas, particularly in China, where local competitors have taken away market share. In response, Nike intends to design more items locally and increase its use of livestream shopping. Meanwhile, the business in India remains very promising, with expectations to triple operations there over the next five years.
paragraphs.zh: 該公司也面臨海外挑戰，特別是在中國，當地競爭對手已搶走市佔率。對此，Nike打算在當地設計更多商品並增加直播購物的使用。同時，印度的業務依然十分有前景，預期在未來五年內當地的營運規模將成長三倍。

grammar.point: 現在分詞當形容詞 (Present Participle as Adjective)
grammar.explain: 用現在分詞 declining 來修飾名詞 sales，表示主動或進行中的狀態。
grammar.example: Nike is currently working on a turnaround plan after facing several years of flat or declining sales and a drop in stock price.
grammar.focus: declining

grammar.point: 目的副詞片語 (Adverbial Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 用不定詞片語 to rebuild the business 來表達採取行動的目的（為了重建業務）。
grammar.example: To rebuild the business, Hill plans to improve product innovation and restore partnerships with independent stores.
grammar.focus: To rebuild the business

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 使用「be + 過去分詞」(are taken away) 來表達主詞 market share 承受被奪走的動作。
grammar.example: The company also faces challenges overseas, particularly in China, where local competitors have taken away market share.
grammar.focus: have taken away

lessons.title: This museum wants you to get sweaty while enjoying its art
lessons.title_zh: 這間博物館想讓你在欣賞藝術時揮灑汗水

paragraphs.en: A museum in western Germany is offering a unique experience that combines physical exercise with fine art. At the Kunstpalast in Düsseldorf, visitors can now use more than 70 pieces of gym equipment while taking in paintings, sculptures, and installations.
paragraphs.zh: 位於德國西部的一家博物館正在提供一項結合體育鍛鍊與純藝術的獨特體驗。在德國杜塞道夫的藝術宮（Kunstpalast），訪客現在可以一邊使用超過 70 件健身器材，一邊欣賞繪畫、雕塑與裝置藝術。

paragraphs.en: The unusual exhibition, titled "GYM. Fit with Art," was launched to mark the centenary of a major historical social welfare and health event that took place in the city in 1926. The new show features a fitness circuit with over 20 stations designed to build strength, stamina, and agility.
paragraphs.zh: 這場名為「GYM. Fit with Art」的不尋常展覽旨在紀念 1926 年在該市舉行的一場重大歷史社會福利與健康活動滿一百週年。這檔新展覽包含一個擁有超過 20 個站點的健身循環訓練，旨在建立力量、耐力與敏捷度。

paragraphs.en: General director Felix Krämer stated that the project brings together two areas that seem to have little in common. The attraction runs until February 21 and is open to anyone with a museum ticket or a specific fitness club membership.
paragraphs.zh: 總館長菲利克斯·克雷默（Felix Krämer）表示，這個計畫將兩個看似毫無共同點的領域結合在一起。該展覽將展出至 2 月 21 日，開放給持有博物館門票或特定健身俱樂部會籍的任何人參觀。

paragraphs.en: While some visitors are irritated by the unconventional setup, deputy head of education Alina Fuchte noted that the initiative has successfully attracted new people who might not otherwise visit. Organizers have provided video instructions, an app, and on-site trainers at weekends to ensure everything is safe.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然有些訪客對這種非傳統的設置感到惱火，但副教育主管艾琳娜·富赫特（Alina Fuchte）指出，這項倡議成功吸引了原本可能不會來參觀的新訪客。主辦單位已提供影片說明、一個應用程式以及週末的現場教練，以確保一切安全。

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 用來強調動作的承受者，句型為 be 動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: The unusual exhibition, titled "GYM. Fit with Art," was launched to mark the centenary of a major historical social welfare and health event that took place in the city in 1926.
grammar.focus: was launched

grammar.point: 關係代名詞子句 (Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 用關係代名詞引導形容詞子句，用來修飾前面的先行詞。
grammar.example: The new show features a fitness circuit with over 20 stations designed to build strength, stamina, and agility.
grammar.focus: designed to build strength, stamina, and agility

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞用 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用「to + 原形動詞」來表達做某個動作的目的，回答「為什麼」的問題。
grammar.example: Organizers have provided video instructions, an app, and on-site trainers at weekends to ensure everything is safe.
grammar.focus: to ensure everything is safe

lessons.title: I let Siri listen to my conversations for weeks. Here’s what it got right — and very wrong
lessons.title_zh: 我讓 Siri 聽了我的對話好幾週。以下是它做對的地方——以及錯得離譜的地方

paragraphs.en: A user recently discovered that their Apple Watch generated a summary of a private conversation with their husband. This happened because they turned on a new feature called Siri Recap, which is designed to monitor chats and create high-level summaries. Apple introduced this tool to make its products more personal and helpful through artificial intelligence, as the iPhone maker competes with other tech giants to build advanced AI assistants.
paragraphs.zh: 一位使用者最近發現，他們的 Apple Watch 產生了一份與丈夫私下對話的摘要。這發生在他們開啟了一項名為 Siri Recap 的新功能之後，該功能旨在監控聊天內容並建立高階摘要。蘋果推出這項工具是為了透過人工智慧讓其產品更具個人化且更有幫助，因為這家 iPhone 製造商正與其他科技巨頭競爭，以建構先進的 AI 助手。

paragraphs.en: To address privacy concerns, Apple designed the system so that it does not record or save audio, identify speakers, or produce a full transcript. The watch captures audio in a secure section of its processor, translates it into a short text version, and sends that text to Apple's cloud platform for summarization. The original audio is discarded before it leaves the user's phone, and the recaps are intentionally kept vague to protect user privacy.
paragraphs.zh: 為了解決隱私疑慮，蘋果設計該系統時使其不會錄製或儲存音訊、辨識說話者，或產生完整的逐字稿。手錶在其處理器的安全區域中擷取音訊，將其翻譯成短文字版本，並將該文字傳送至蘋果的雲端平台進行摘要。原始音訊在離開使用者的手機之前就會被捨棄，且摘要刻意保持模糊以保護使用者隱私。

paragraphs.en: However, this lack of detail creates certain disadvantages. Because the summaries omit specific names and details, they are often too vague to be useful, and experts point out that capturing audio at all can still feel worrisome. Furthermore, the feature currently lacks a visual indicator when activated because it does not actually record, which can make it harder to explain to people around the user.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，這種缺乏細節的情況也帶來了某些缺點。由於摘要省略了特定的名稱與細節，它們通常過於模糊而沒有用處，且專家指出，擷取音訊這件事本身仍然會讓人感到擔憂。此外，該功能目前在啟動時缺乏視覺指示燈，因為它實際上並未錄音，這可能會讓人更難向使用者周遭的人解釋。

paragraphs.en: While some users found the tool helpful for remembering details like restaurant recommendations or meeting overviews, others encountered inaccuracies. For instance, Siri once mistook a karaoke party for a music trivia event and incorrectly assumed the user was producing a musical. These limitations highlight the broader challenge that Apple faces as it tries to balance creating a smarter assistant with protecting user privacy.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然有些使用者發現該工具對於記住餐廳推薦或會議概述等細節很有幫助，但其他人也遇到了不準確的情況。例如，Siri 曾將一場卡拉OK派對誤認為是音樂益智問答活動，並錯誤地假設使用者正在製作音樂劇。這些限制突顯了蘋果在試圖平衡「打造更聰明的助手」與「保護使用者隱私」時所面臨的更廣泛挑戰。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 說明先行詞 a new feature，引導形容詞子句修飾前面的名詞。
grammar.example: A user recently discovered that their Apple Watch generated a summary of a private conversation with their husband.
grammar.focus: that their Apple Watch generated a summary of a private conversation with their husband

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 表示主詞受到動作的影響，結構為 be 動詞加上過去分詞。
grammar.example: The original audio is discarded before it leaves the user's phone, and the recaps are intentionally kept vague to protect user privacy.
grammar.focus: is discarded

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞用 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 置於句尾用來補充說明動作發生的目的，譯為「為了……」。
grammar.example: These limitations highlight the broader challenge that Apple faces as it tries to balance creating a smarter assistant with protecting user privacy.
grammar.focus: to balance creating a smarter assistant with protecting user privacy

lessons.title: 12 strategies to cut your risk of dementia. Take this quiz to start
lessons.title_zh: 降低失智症風險的12種策略：做這個測驗開始行動

paragraphs.en: Many people dread losing their memory as they age. For decades, individuals believed dementia was simply a result of genetics or bad luck. However, medical opinions have shifted radically. In 2024, an international panel of experts known as the Lancet Commission reported that roughly 45% of dementia cases might be avoided or delayed by targeting 14 modifiable risk factors. A major clinical trial named U.S. POINTER also showed that older adults could protect their thinking skills by combining physical activity, nutritious meals, mental exercises, and social interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 許多人害怕隨著年齡增長而失去記憶。幾十年來，大家一直認為失智症純粹是基因或運氣不好的結果。然而，醫學界的看法已發生了根本性的轉變。在2024年，名為刺絡針委員會（Lancet Commission）的國際專家小組報告指出，透過針對14種可改變的風險因素，大約45%的失智症病例或許可以被預防或延緩。一項名為U.S. POINTER的大型臨床試驗也顯示，年長者若能結合體能活動、營養膳食、心智運動以及社交互動，便能保護自己的思考能力。

paragraphs.en: To help the public begin, a neurologist named Jonathan Rosand from Massachusetts General Hospital and his team created a free five-minute online survey called the Brain Care Score. Backed by the Global Brain Care Coalition, the test evaluates 12 factors divided into three main areas. Rosand notes that the tool gives people clear options to protect themselves against dementia, stroke, and depression, while guiding them toward a longer and healthier life.
paragraphs.zh: 為了幫助大眾起步，麻省總醫院（Massachusetts General Hospital）的神經學家喬納森．羅桑德（Jonathan Rosand）和他的團隊設計了一項名為「大腦照護分數」（Brain Care Score）的免費五分鐘線上測驗。在「全球大腦照護聯盟」（Global Brain Care Coalition）的支持下，這項測驗評估了分為三大領域的12項因素。羅桑德指出，這項工具為人們提供了明確的選擇來保護自己免於失智症、中風和憂鬱症的威脅，同時引導他們邁向更長壽、更健康的生活。

paragraphs.en: The first step in calculating a score involves learning key physical numbers, including blood pressure, blood sugar, cholesterol, and body weight. Rosand emphasizes that high blood pressure damages blood vessels over time, making them more likely to rupture or become blocked. Consequently, taking prescribed medicine for elevated blood pressure is one of the most vital habits for reducing long-term risks to the brain.
paragraphs.zh: 計算分數的第一步是了解關鍵的身體數值，包括血壓、血糖、膽固醇和體重。羅桑德強調，高血壓會隨著時間損害血管，使血管更有可能破裂或阻塞。因此，服用處方的高血壓藥物是降低大腦長期風險最為重要的習慣之一。

paragraphs.en: Examining real-world data from thousands of participants, researchers discovered that each one-point increase in the Brain Care Score was tied to as much as a 4% reduction in the risk of stroke, dementia, or late-life depression. Experts stress that there is no requirement to remodel your entire routine overnight. Instead, picking a single doable adjustment, such as improving sleep, often creates positive ripple effects that make regular exercise and healthy eating easier.
paragraphs.zh: 研究人員在檢視數千名參與者的真實世界資料時發現，「大腦照護分數」每提高一分，中風、失智症或晚年憂鬱症的風險最多可降低4%。專家強調，完全沒有必要在一夕之間徹底改變整個生活作息。相反地，挑選一項可行的微調，例如改善睡眠，通常會產生正面的連鎖反應，讓規律運動和健康飲食變得更容易。

paragraphs.en: The scoring system also highlights the protective power of social bonds and personal meaning. According to a 2025 study, people with a stronger sense of purpose were approximately 28% less likely to experience cognitive decline. This suggests that participating in a local class or volunteering can serve as genuine brain care. Because healthy routines can spread to others, sharing this quick test with friends might inspire everyone to build better habits.
paragraphs.zh: 這套評分系統也強調了社交連結與個人生活目標的保護力量。根據2025年的一項研究，擁有較強目標感的人，出現認知能力退化的機率降低了大約28%。這表明參加社區課程或擔任志工都可以算是一種真正的大腦照護。由於健康的日常習慣會互相傳染，與朋友分享這項快速測驗可能會激勵每個人建立起更好的習慣。

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 句首使用「To + 原形動詞」構成的不定詞片語，用來說明研發該測驗的主要目的。
grammar.example: To help the public begin, a neurologist named Jonathan Rosand from Massachusetts General Hospital and his team created a free five-minute online survey called the Brain Care Score.
grammar.focus: To help the public begin

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 由助動詞 might 搭配「be + 過去分詞 (avoided / delayed)」構成，表示失智症病例「被避免或延緩」。
grammar.example: In 2024, an international panel of experts known as the Lancet Commission reported that roughly 45% of dementia cases might be avoided or delayed by targeting 14 modifiable risk factors.
grammar.focus: might be avoided or delayed

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Clause)
grammar.explain: 以逗號隔開的現在分詞短語 (making...) 作為分詞構句，修飾前方的主要子句，表示高血壓損害血管後產生的連帶結果。
grammar.example: Rosand emphasizes that high blood pressure damages blood vessels over time, making them more likely to rupture or become blocked.
grammar.focus: , making them more likely to rupture or become blocked

lessons.title: Screen-free tweens try their hand at Dungeons & Dragons
lessons.title_zh: 遠離螢幕的青少年初試身手玩《龍與地下城》

paragraphs.en: First published in 1974, the fantasy tabletop game Dungeons & Dragons has fascinated players for over fifty years. In its early days, some parents worried that the role-playing game kept children indoors for hours, leading NPR to report on it in 1979. Recently, however, the game has returned to mainstream culture through the television show Stranger Things, a 2023 blockbuster movie, and increased interest during COVID-19 lockdowns.
paragraphs.zh: 奇幻桌上遊戲《龍與地下城》（Dungeons & Dragons）於1974年首次發行，五十多年來一直深深吸引著玩家。在早期，一些家長擔心這款角色扮演遊戲讓孩子們一連數小時待在室內，促使全國公共廣播電台（NPR）於1979年為此製作了一則報導。然而，近來這款遊戲藉由電視劇《怪奇物語》（Stranger Things）、一部2023年的熱門賣座電影，以及COVID-19封鎖期間激增的興趣，重返主流文化。

paragraphs.en: What was once viewed as a nerdy hobby has now transformed into an ideal screen-free activity for modern parents. The game depends on imagination, rolling dice, and face-to-face interaction rather than electronic devices. In Washington Heights, New York, an adult named Ted Fair serves as a Dungeon Master for a group of children aged nine to twelve. His group belongs to Tweens Without Screens, an organization run by parents that arranges technology-free events such as knitting clubs, city hikes, and monthly gaming sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 這項曾經被視為怪咖消遣的嗜好，如今已轉變為現代家長眼中無螢幕的理想活動。這款遊戲仰賴想像力、擲骰子以及面對面的互動，而非電子設備。在紐約華盛頓高地（Washington Heights），一位名叫泰德·費爾（Ted Fair）的成年人擔任一群九至十二歲孩童的「地下城主」（Dungeon Master）。他的小組隸屬於「無螢幕青少年」（Tweens Without Screens），這是一個由家長運作的組織，專門安排針織社團、城市健行以及每月遊戲聚會等不使用科技的活動。

paragraphs.en: During a recent adventure, the young adventurers investigated a cave and found a mysterious egg that might have belonged to a dragon. Unfortunately, an unlucky dice roll caused the egg to smash onto the ground instead of being quietly stolen. Despite the mishap, twelve-year-old Rose Watson enjoyed the shared excitement. She explained that a major attraction is gathering with friends to share jokes and imagine stories together, while her nine-year-old brother Leo highlighted the value of collaboration.
paragraphs.zh: 在最近的一次冒險中，這群小小冒險家探索了一座洞穴，並發現一顆可能屬於巨龍的神秘蛋。不幸的是，一次不走運的擲骰結果導致蛋摔碎在地面上，而不是被順利偷走。儘管發生了這起意外，十二歲的蘿絲·華森（Rose Watson）依然享受這份共同的樂趣。她解釋說，最大的吸引力在於與朋友聚在一起開玩笑並共同構思故事，而她九歲的弟弟里奧·華森（Leo Watson）則強調了合作的價值。

paragraphs.en: Instead of touching digital screens, these players rely on pencils, printed character sheets, and rule books. Nine-year-old Amos Slodounik appreciates how the fantasy setting allows him to explore different personalities and act playfully without fear of judgment. Another nine-year-old member, Benjamin Cho, spends his time inventing unusual equipment and magical creatures, such as a healing spider donut. For these children, the classic game proves that limitless adventures can happen entirely in their own minds.
paragraphs.zh: 這些玩家不碰數位螢幕，而是依賴鉛筆、印製好的角色卡和規則書。九歲的阿莫斯·斯洛杜尼克（Amos Slodounik）很喜歡這種奇幻設定讓他能夠探索不同的性格，並且調皮玩鬧而不用害怕受到評判。另一位同樣九歲的成員班傑明·趙（Benjamin Cho）則花時間發明不尋常的裝備與魔法生物，例如一個具有治癒效果的蜘蛛甜甜圈。對這些孩子而言，這款經典遊戲證明了無限的冒險完全可以在他們自己的腦海中展開。

grammar.point: 分詞構句修飾主詞 (Participial Phrase Modifying the Subject)
grammar.explain: 由過去分詞 published 引導的片語作修飾語，說明主詞 the fantasy tabletop game Dungeons & Dragons 在過去被發行的被動狀態。
grammar.example: First published in 1974, the fantasy tabletop game Dungeons & Dragons has fascinated players for over fifty years.
grammar.focus: First published in 1974

grammar.point: 複合關係代名詞引導名詞子句 (Noun Clause with What)
grammar.explain: what 引導名詞子句在句中作主要子句的主詞，相當於 the thing that。
grammar.example: What was once viewed as a nerdy hobby has now transformed into an ideal screen-free activity for modern parents.
grammar.focus: What was once viewed as a nerdy hobby

grammar.point: 介係詞片語引導動名詞 (Prepositional Phrase with Gerund)
grammar.explain: 介係詞 instead of 後接動名詞被動形式 being stolen，用以表示「而不是被……」。
grammar.example: Unfortunately, an unlucky dice roll caused the egg to smash onto the ground instead of being quietly stolen.
grammar.focus: instead of being quietly stolen

lessons.title: California voters pass billionaire's measure to bankroll his own medical lab
lessons.title_zh: 加州選民通過億萬富翁的提案來資助他自己的醫療實驗室

paragraphs.en: California voters recently approved a ballot measure known as Proposition 38, which will authorize the state to borrow $8.4 billion for immunology research. Half of this massive funding is slated to go directly to a single research institute supported by Gary Michelson, the Southern California billionaire who put the measure on the ballot.
paragraphs.zh: 加州選民最近通過了一項被稱為第38號提案的投票提案，該提案將授權該州借入84億美元用於免疫學研究。這筆巨額資金的一半預計將直接流向由南加州億萬富翁蓋瑞·麥克森（Gary Michelson）支持的一家研究機構，正是他將該提案提交投票的。

paragraphs.en: The measure has sparked a fierce debate among patients and experts alike. Former state legislative analyst Marianne O'Malley studied the details and expressed deep concern. She pointed out that the initiative effectively redirects public money toward a private philanthropic project.
paragraphs.zh: 該提案在患者和專家之間引發了激烈的爭論。前州立法分析師瑪麗安·歐馬利（Marianne O'Malley）研究了細節並表達了深深的擔憂。她指出，該倡議實際上將公共資金轉向了私人慈善計畫。

paragraphs.en: On the other hand, some patients who have benefited from advanced medical treatments support the proposal. Laurie Adami, a blood cancer survivor, received a revolutionary immunotherapy called CAR-T in 2018 and has been cancer-free ever since. She strongly believes that more patients should be able to access life-saving treatments.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，一些受益於先進醫療的患者則支持這項提案。血癌倖存者勞瑞·亞達米（Laurie Adami）在2018年接受了一種名為CAR-T的革命性免疫療法，此後一直沒有癌症。她堅信更多的患者應該能夠獲得拯救生命的治療。

paragraphs.en: However, critics remain skeptical about the financial claims made by the campaign. Another retired legislative analyst, Dan Carson, argued that the odds of finding enough successful new treatments are extremely low, comparing it to an earlier stem cell research bond that failed to deliver its promised returns to the state.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，批評人士對競選活動提出的財務聲明仍然持懷疑態度。另一位退休立法分析師丹·卡森（Dan Carson）辯稱，找到足夠成功的的新治療方法的機率極低，他將其與早期未能向該州兌現承諾回報的幹細胞研究債券進行了比較。

paragraphs.en: Although Michelson's campaign is confident that the fast-growing global market will generate enough revenue to repay the bond with interest, many questions remain about the true impact of this public funding.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管麥克森的競選團隊有信心快速增長的全球市場將產生足夠的收入來連本帶利償還債券，但對於這筆公共資金的真正影響仍然存在許多疑問。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 使用關係代名詞which引導子句，用來補充說明前面的先行詞Proposition 38。
grammar.example: California voters recently approved a ballot measure known as Proposition 38, which will authorize the state to borrow $8.4 billion for immunology research.
grammar.focus: which will authorize the state to borrow $8.4 billion for immunology research

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 使用「be + 過去分詞」結構來表達主詞受到的動作，此處強調資金被預定要流向何處。
grammar.example: Half of this massive funding is slated to go directly to a single research institute supported by Gary Michelson, the Southern California billionaire who put the measure on the ballot.
grammar.focus: is slated to go

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participle Clause)
grammar.explain: 使用過去分詞v.-ed作為形容詞用法，修飾前面的名詞institute，表示被支援的機構。
grammar.example: Half of this massive funding is slated to go directly to a single research institute supported by Gary Michelson, the Southern California billionaire who put the measure on the ballot.
grammar.focus: supported by Gary Michelson

lessons.title: This week in science: anxiety in college students, potatoes on the moon and whale snot
lessons.title_zh: 本週科學新聞：大學生焦慮情緒、月球馬鈴薯與鯨魚鼻涕

paragraphs.en: In a recent science podcast, researchers discussed several fascinating topics, including growing anxiety among young adults, simulating lunar farming, and studying whale DNA through snot. Experts note that anxiety has risen significantly over the past fifteen years among Gen Z and young millennials, coinciding with the widespread use of smartphones.
paragraphs.zh: 在最近的一期科學廣播節目中，研究人員討論了幾個引人入勝的主題，包括年輕成人的焦慮感上升、模擬月球農業，以及透過鼻涕研究鯨魚DNA。專家指出，過去十五年間，Z世代與年輕千禧世代的焦慮情緒顯著上升，這與智慧型手機的普及時間點相吻合。

paragraphs.en: A new study published in the Journal of the American Medical Association Psychiatry suggests that a key factor called intolerance of uncertainty has increased during this period. Lead author Jeroen van Baar explains that people who struggle with uncertainty want to know every detail in advance, which can lead to decision fatigue. While smartphones give users thousands of reviews at their fingertips, they also encourage a habit of needing complete information, making it harder to handle unpredictable situations.
paragraphs.zh: 發表在《美國醫學會雜誌：精神病學》上的一項新研究表明，在此期間，一個稱為「對不確定性的不容忍」的關鍵因素有所增加。主要作者傑倫·範巴爾解釋說，難以應付不確定性的人希望事先知道每一個細節，這可能會導致決策疲勞。雖然智慧型手機讓使用者隨時能查閱成千上萬的評論，但也助長了需要完整資訊的習慣，讓人們更難以應付不可預測的情況。

paragraphs.en: Fortunately, experts believe that cognitive behavioral therapy and exposure therapy could help people become more comfortable with uncertainty. Another exciting topic involves NASA's Artemis program, which aims to establish a sustained human presence on the moon by the 2030s. To feed astronauts, plant biologists are testing whether potatoes can grow in simulated lunar dirt mixed with fertilizer and compost.
paragraphs.zh: 幸慶的是，專家相信認知行為治療與暴露治療有助於人們更能適應不確定性。另一個令人興奮的主題涉及美國國家航空暨太空總署的阿提米絲計畫，該計畫旨在2030年代在月球上建立持續的人類存在。為了餵飽太空人，植物生物學家正在測試馬鈴薯是否能在混有肥料與堆肥的模擬月球土壤中生長。

paragraphs.en: Lead researcher Aymeric Goyer from Oregon State University mentions that the harvested potatoes look similar to Earth potatoes and appear safe to eat based on molecular tests. Although actual moon dirt is extremely sharp and difficult to simulate, this research offers hope for future greenhouse farming on the moon. However, astronauts will still need to ship supplies like fertilizer from Earth.
paragraphs.zh: 來自俄勒岡州立大學的主要研究人員艾梅里克·戈耶提到，收穫的馬鈴薯看起來與地球上的馬鈴薯相似，且根據分子測試似乎可以安全食用。儘管真實的月球土壤極為尖銳且難以模擬，這項研究為未來在月球上的溫室農業帶來了希望。然而，太空人仍然需要從地球運送肥料等物資。

paragraphs.en: Finally, scientists have found a unique way to study whales without harming them by collecting whale snot using drones. Marine ecologist Éadin O'Mahony explains that these drones have sterile Petri dishes attached with Velcro to catch the breath of humpback whales. By analyzing the viruses and DNA fragments in these samples, researchers successfully sequenced a whole whale genome, providing crucial insights into the genetic health of northern humpbacks.
paragraphs.zh: 最後，科學家找到了一種不傷害鯨魚而能研究牠們的獨特方法，那就是使用無人機收集鯨魚鼻涕。海洋生態學家艾丹·歐馬尼解釋說，這些無人機上用魔鬼氈黏著無菌培養皿，以捕捉座頭鯨呼吸出的氣體。透過分析這些樣本中的病毒與DNA片段，研究人員成功定序了整個鯨魚基因組，為北方座頭鯨的基因健康提供了關鍵的見解。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞 (Relative Pronoun)
grammar.explain: 說明先行詞 a new study，用 which 引導形容詞子句補充說明發表之處。
grammar.example: A new study published in the Journal of the American Medical Association Psychiatry suggests that a key factor called intolerance of uncertainty has increased during this period.
grammar.focus: published in the Journal of the American Medical Association Psychiatry

grammar.point: 不定詞表目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 用來表示進行一項動作的目的，在此指為了達到餵飽太空人的目標。
grammar.example: To feed astronauts, plant biologists are testing whether potatoes can grow in simulated lunar dirt mixed with fertilizer and compost.
grammar.focus: To feed astronauts

lessons.title: Public health specialist discusses the aftermath of the munitions detonation in Iowa
lessons.title_zh: 公共衛生專家討論愛荷華州軍火爆炸事件之善後工作

paragraphs.en: Public health specialist Will Sander from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign recently discussed the aftermath of an explosion in Iowa. The incident occurred on Wednesday when the Army destroyed its stockpile of lead azide. Linda Ross, who lives about a mile away from the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant located in Middletown, heard and felt the blast.
paragraphs.zh: 伊利諾大學厄巴納-香檳分校的公共衛生專家威爾·桑德最近討論了愛荷華州爆炸事件的善後工作。這起事件發生在週三，當時陸軍摧毀了其疊氮化鉛的存庫。住在位於米德letown的愛荷華陸軍彈藥廠大約一英里處的琳達·羅斯聽到了並感受到了爆炸。

paragraphs.en: The Federal Emergency Management Agency described its work to contain the detonation as a very complex mitigation effort. Although the Environmental Protection Agency stated that lead leaks were not detected, Sander noted that additional detections might still appear, particularly as testing increases in the surrounding soil and water.
paragraphs.zh: 聯邦緊急事務管理署將其控制該次引爆的工作描述為非常複雜的減災努力。儘管環境保護署表示未偵測到鉛洩漏，但桑德指出，隨著對周圍土壤和水的檢測增加，額外的偵測結果可能仍會出現。

paragraphs.en: Many mitigation measures were implemented after a legal challenge and public outcry, which helped provide more safety procedures. Following the blast, the Federal Emergency Management Agency lifted its shelter-in-place order, allowing residents to resume normal activities while remaining cautious about dust and material accumulation.
paragraphs.zh: 許多減災措施是在法律挑戰和公眾強烈抗議之後才實施的，這有助於提供更多的安全程序。爆炸發生後，聯邦緊急事務管理署解除了就地避難令，允許居民恢復正常活動，同時對灰塵和物質堆積保持警惕。

paragraphs.en: Sander suggested that residents should stay inside a bit longer and wear masks if they need to go outdoors. Regarding long-term risks, the specialist explained that it is still too early to assess them, and monitoring will need to continue for weeks or months to ensure community safety.
paragraphs.zh: 桑德建議居民應該在室內待久一點，如果需要外出則佩戴口罩。關於長期風險，這位專家解釋說現在評估還為時過早，且需要持續監測數週或數月以確保社區安全。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞子句 (Relative clause)
grammar.explain: 本句使用關係代名詞 who 引導形容詞子句，用來修飾前面的專有名詞 Linda Ross。
grammar.example: Linda Ross, who lives about a mile away from the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant located in Middletown, heard and felt the blast.
grammar.focus: who lives about a mile away from the Iowa Army Ammunition Plant located in Middletown

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive voice)
grammar.explain: 本句使用「be 動詞 + 過去分詞 (were implemented)」構成被動語態，強調措施是被執行的。
grammar.example: Many mitigation measures were implemented after a legal challenge and public outcry, which helped provide more safety procedures.
grammar.focus: were implemented

grammar.point: 分詞構句 (Participial phrase)
grammar.explain: 本句使用現在分詞片語作為附加的表述，表示在恢復正常活動的同時保持警惕。
grammar.example: Following the blast, the Federal Emergency Management Agency lifted its shelter-in-place order, allowing residents to resume normal activities while remaining cautious about dust and material accumulation.
grammar.focus: allowing residents to resume normal activities

lessons.title: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
lessons.title_zh: 聯邦通信委員會表示SpaceX可部署100萬顆衛星用於太空資料中心 科學家持懷疑態度

paragraphs.en: The United States Federal Communications Commission (FCC) recently approved a plan by SpaceX to deploy one million satellites to create data centers in space. The Trump administration gave the rocket company, led by Elon Musk, the green light to build a satellite constellation called Starmind. The FCC stated that these orbital compute modules will process large amounts of data for use back on Earth.
paragraphs.zh: 美國聯邦通信委員會（FCC）最近批准了一項SpaceX的計畫，將部署一百萬顆衛星在太空中建立資料中心。川普政府為這家由伊隆·馬斯克領導的火箭公司開綠燈，建造名為「Starmind」的衛星星系。聯邦通信委員會表示，這些軌道計算模組將處理大量資料，供地球上使用。

paragraphs.en: According to the official authorization order, the company must launch at least one authorized space station by the year 2033. After that, the company will gradually add more satellites through 2040. FCC Chairman Brendan Carr mentioned that this decision opens a bold new frontier and helps America lead the world into the era of super intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: 根據官方授權命令，該公司必須在2033年之前發射至少一個獲授權的太空站。此後，該公司將在2040年之前逐步增加更多衛星。聯邦通信委員會主席布倫丹·卡爾提到，這項決定開闢了一個大膽的新邊界，並有助於美國領導世界進入超級智慧時代。

paragraphs.en: However, the project has raised serious concerns among scientists and industry experts. Astrophysicist Adam Becker called the prospect of launching a million satellites a fantasy, stating that it is not going to happen. Experts point out that although space is cold, it acts like a vacuum that traps heat inside objects, making it very difficult and expensive to cool the equipment.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，這項計畫在科學家和產業專家之間引發了嚴重的擔憂。天體物理學家亞當·貝克稱發射一百萬顆衛星的前景為幻想，並表示這是不會發生的。專家指出，雖然太空很冷，但它就像一個將熱量困在物體內的真空，使得冷卻設備變得非常困難且昂貴。

paragraphs.en: In addition, critics warn about other major risks, including atmospheric pollution from rocket launches and dangerous in-orbit collisions. Such crashes could create a massive cloud of debris in low Earth orbit. Organizations such as the American Astronomical Society (AAS) also warned that these extremely bright satellites would severely damage astronomical research and block the public from enjoying the night sky.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，批評者警告其他主要風險，包括火箭發射造成的大氣汙染以及危險的軌道內碰撞。此類撞擊可能會在低地球軌道上產生大量的碎片雲。美國天文學會（AAS）等組織也警告說，這些極其明亮的衛星將嚴重損害天文研究，並阻礙大眾欣賞夜空。

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用「to + 原形動詞」來表達做某個動作的目的，在此處用來解釋建立資料中心的原因。
grammar.example: The Trump administration gave the rocket company, led by Elon Musk, the green light to build a satellite constellation called Starmind.
grammar.focus: to build a satellite constellation called Starmind

grammar.point: 關係代名詞子句 (Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 使用關係代名詞 which 引導形容詞子句，用來修飾前面的先行詞 modules。
grammar.example: The FCC stated that these orbital compute modules will process large amounts of data for use back on Earth.
grammar.focus: that these orbital compute modules will process large amounts of data for use back on Earth

grammar.point: 被動語態 (Passive Voice)
grammar.explain: 使用「be動詞 + 過去分詞」結構，強調動作的承受者。
grammar.example: According to the official authorization order, the company must launch at least one authorized space station by the year 2033.
grammar.focus: authorized

lessons.title: How to talk AI around the Thanksgiving table
lessons.title_zh: 如何在感恩節餐桌上談論人工智慧

paragraphs.en: As families gather for Thanksgiving dinner, holiday conversations can sometimes become tense. People usually try to avoid sensitive topics like politics or religion, but recent years have introduced a brand new conversational challenge: artificial intelligence.
paragraphs.zh: 當家庭聚在一起享用感恩節晚餐時，節日對話有時會變得緊張。人們通常試圖避免政治或宗教等敏感話題，但近年來出現了一個全新的對話挑戰：人工智慧。

paragraphs.en: To help people navigate this emerging topic, the National Public Radio (NPR) podcast Machine Gods recently shared some friendly advice. Podcast hosts Kevin Roose and Casey Newton discussed how listeners can approach AI discussions with their relatives during the holidays.
paragraphs.zh: 為了幫助人們應對這個新興話題，國家公共廣播電台（NPR）的播客節目《機器神》（Machine Gods）最近分享了一些友善的建議。播客主持人凱文·魯斯（Kevin Roose）與卡西·牛頓（Casey Newton）討論了聽眾如何在假期中與親戚進行人工智慧的討論。

paragraphs.en: The hosts first suggest a very direct method to understand the technology. As Newton explains, you should simply ask family members to try it, noting that you have to see a computer using itself to truly grasp what is happening.
paragraphs.zh: 主持人首先建議了一個理解該技術的非常直接的方法。正如牛頓所解釋的，你應該直接請家庭成員試用它，並指出你必須親眼看到電腦自行運作，才能真正理解正在發生什麼事。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, the hosts recommend adjusting your approach based on your family's current level of knowledge. If relatives have never used the technology, you can simply hand them a phone to ask a question or write a poem.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，主持人建議根據家人目前的知識水準來調整你的應對方式。如果親戚從未使用過這項技術，你可以直接把手機交給他們，請它回答問題或寫一首詩。

paragraphs.en: On the other hand, if your family is already well-informed and worried about local data centers, you can discuss more complex subjects like recursive self-improvement. Interestingly, the hosts point out that AI discussions are not predictable in a polarized way, which could help people find common ground.
paragraphs.zh: 另一方面，如果你的家人已經見聞廣博且擔心當地的資料中心，你可以討論更複雜的主題，例如遞迴自我提升。有趣的是，主持人指出，人工智慧的討論並不會以極化的方式呈現出可預測的結果，這可能有助於人們找到共鳴。

grammar.point: 不定詞作目的副詞片語 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 用來表達某個動作的目的，回答「為什麼」的問題。
grammar.example: To help people navigate this emerging topic, the National Public Radio (NPR) podcast Machine Gods recently shared some friendly advice.
grammar.focus: To help people navigate this emerging topic

grammar.point: 受詞子句 (Object Clause)
grammar.explain: 由連接詞引導作為動詞受詞的子句，補充說明內容。
grammar.example: Podcast hosts Kevin Roose and Casey Newton discussed how listeners can approach AI discussions with their relatives during the holidays.
grammar.focus: how listeners can approach AI discussions with their relatives during the holidays

lessons.title: China sends first foreign astronaut to ISS rival as it globalises space operations
lessons.title_zh: 中國送第一位外國太空人至天宮太空站，太空任務走向全球化

paragraphs.en: China recently flew its first foreign astronaut to the Tiangong space station, starting what it calls the global expansion of its space missions. Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, a forty-year-old air force pilot and payload specialist from Pakistan, became the first Pakistani to reach orbit. He floated through a hatch to enter the Chinese station, where the onboard crew warmly embraced him in an event described as the nation's first foreign space handshake.
paragraphs.zh: 中國最近將第一位外國太空人送往天宮太空站，開啟了其所稱太空任務的全球擴展。現年四十歲的巴基斯坦空軍飛行員兼酬載專家穆罕默德·齊尚·阿里（Muhammad Zeeshan Ali），成為第一位進入軌道的巴基斯坦人。他飄過艙口進入中國太空站時，機組人員熱情地擁抱了他，這場活動被形容為該國第一次外國「太空握手」。

paragraphs.en: Completed in 2022, Tiangong is the pride of China's space program. The government has put billions of dollars into its celestial ambitions to catch up with the United States and Russia. Meanwhile, the International Space Station (ISS), which involves five partners including the US, Russia, Europe, Japan, and Canada, is set to stop operating by 2030 after twenty-five years of continuous occupation. Chinese President Xi Jinping recently told his Pakistani counterpart that Beijing is willing to work with all countries to support the peaceful use of outer space.
paragraphs.zh: 天宮於2022年完工，是中國太空計畫的驕傲。政府已在其太空雄心上投入數十億美元，以趕上美國與俄羅斯。同時，包含美國、俄羅斯、歐洲、日本與加拿大等五個夥伴的國際太空站（ISS），在持續運作二十五年後，預計將於2030年停止營運。中國國家主席習近平最近告訴巴基斯坦同僚，北京願意與所有國家合作，以支持和平利用外太空。

paragraphs.en: Ali joined the crew of Shenzhou 24, a mission that rotates astronauts every six months. Industry experts point out that sending another country's astronaut into space is a major undertaking that shows China is open to this type of collaboration. Space cooperation between Beijing and Islamabad has a long history, dating back to the early 1990s. The Shenzhou 24 spacecraft blasted off from the Jiuquan launch center on Wednesday and docked with the space station three and a half hours later.
paragraphs.zh: 阿里加入了神舟二十四號的機組行列，這項任務每六個月輪換一次太空人。產業專家指出，將其他國家的太空人送入太空是一項重大工程，顯示中國對此類合作抱持開放態度。北京與伊斯蘭馬巴德之間的太空合作歷史悠久，可以追溯到1990年代初期。神舟二十四號太空船於週三從酒泉發射中心升空，並在三個半小時後與太空站對接。

paragraphs.en: During his time on Tiangong, Ali will perform several tests, including growing microalgae for potential food use and checking how spaceflight affects quinoa seeds. To get ready for this journey, he trained in Beijing for seven months and took intensive Chinese language classes. Unlike typical crew members who stay for six months, Ali will return to Earth early with two members of the Shenzhou 23 crew.
paragraphs.zh: 在天宮期間，阿里將進行幾項測試，包括培育微藻作為潛在食物用途，以及檢視太空飛行如何影響藜麥種子。為了準備這趟旅程，他在北京訓練了七個月，並上了密集的中華語文課程。與通常停留六個月的典型機組人員不同，阿里將與神舟二十三號的兩名成員提早返回地球。

paragraphs.en: Beijing's fast progress in space has made its rivals nervous. China is only the third nation to send humans into orbit and has already landed robotic rovers on both Mars and the moon. As the ISS nears the end of its operational life and western commercial plans remain uncertain, analysts note that China could soon have the only permanently crewed station in low Earth orbit, allowing the country to expand its global engagement.
paragraphs.zh: 北京在太空領域的快速進展讓其對手感到緊張。中國是第三個將人類送入軌道的國家，並且已經在火星和月球上降落了機器人探測車。隨著國際太空站接近其運作壽命的尾聲，且西方商業計畫仍充滿不確定性，分析師指出，中國可能很快就會擁有低地球軌道上唯一常態性有人駐守的太空站，這將允許該國擴大其全球參與。

grammar.point: 關係代名詞子句 (Relative Clause)
grammar.explain: 使用關代 which引導形容詞子句，用來修飾並補充說明前面的名詞 the International Space Station (ISS)。
grammar.example: Meanwhile, the International Space Station (ISS), which involves five partners including the US, Russia, Europe, Japan, and Canada, is set to stop operating by 2030 after twenty-five years of continuous occupation.
grammar.focus: which involves five partners including the US, Russia, Europe, Japan, and Canada

grammar.point: 不定詞表示目的 (Infinitive of Purpose)
grammar.explain: 使用 to catch up with 引導副詞片語，用來表達政府投入數十億美元的目的。
grammar.example: The government has put billions of dollars into its celestial ambitions to catch up with the United States and Russia.
grammar.focus: to catch up with the United States and Russia
